relations_to.summary: Bangladesh took the BIMSTEC chair from Thailand at the Bangkok summit of 4 Apr 2025 for two years (the secretariat is in Dhaka); the summit signed a maritime-transport cooperation agreement and Yunus met Modi on the sidelines. In September 2026 India invited Rahman to the BRICS outreach only in his capacity as BIMSTEC chair, which Dhaka took as a slight.

sources.title: Bimstec sidelines: Yunus, Modi first-ever in-person meeting set for 4 April
India invites Bangladesh PM Tarique Rahman to BRICS outreach session in capacity as BIMSTEC chair
